text:
Morgan: quick check — opened a PR to make the GPU node pool AZ-aware and add soft capacity reservations per AZ. goal is to spread reserved capacity so a single AZ preempt doesn't kill X% of our GPU capacity. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/infra/pulls/4321

Kai: looking now. high-level q: are we creating separate nodepools per AZ or one pool with mixed zones?

Morgan: separate nodepools per AZ (k8s nodegroups), each with reserved on-demand capacity + spot fallback. terraform changes in modules/gpu_pool/main.tf and modules/gpu_pool/vars.tf. snippet:```hcl
module "gpu_pool" {
  source = "./modules/gpu_pool"
  zones  = var.zones
  reserve_per_az = 2
  gpu_instance_types = ["nvidia-a100:1", "nvidia-a100:2"]
}
```

Devon: nit: you probably want explicit instance_family selection rather than colon syntax? also need to surface instanceSku for cloud provider when reserving capacity — otherwise we might get different hardware in each AZ.

Sasha: two ops concerns: 1) autoscaler config — make sure `cluster-autoscaler` has per-group scaling thresholds. 2) taints/tolerations so non-GPU pods don't land on these nodes during shortages.

Morgan: yep re autoscaler, adding labels: `k8s.io/role=gpu, redwood/gpu-zone=<az>` and taint `redwood/gpu:NoSchedule` for reserved nodes. will add tolerations to job profiles.

Kai: about secrets wiring — I saw a change referencing `ssm:/gpu/reservations/token` in the module. we should not read secrets during terraform plan/apply on CI; instead reference ARN and let kube secrets be populated by vault-agent or ssm-agent at runtime.

Morgan: good catch. current code had:```hcl
resource "aws_ssm_parameter" "gpu_token" {
  name  = "/gpu/reservations/token"
  type  = "SecureString"
  value = var.reservation_token # this is coming from tfvars in CI
}
```
I can switch to outputting the parameter name and let ops populate it out-of-band.

Devon: also add finalizer so nodepool deletion doesn't drop GPUs while jobs are mid-run. add lifecycle block on k8s nodegroup resource? or we handle at app level.

Sasha: small ask — add a `preempt_fallback_policy` param so that when reserved capacity is low we automatically relax GPU selectors and schedule to mixed-instance pool. saves a manual rollback.

Morgan: planning to implement `preempt_fallback_policy = "spill_to_mixed" | "wait"` default `spill_to_mixed`. will include a canary flag for one team to test.

PJ: for PR review — include a short rollout plan in the PR description: how we'll drain, canary in us-west-2b for 2 hours, monitor pod OOM/evictions, metrics to watch: `gpu_utilization`, `kube_pod_evictions`, `node_unschedulable`. Also add `infra-runbook.md` link.

infra-bot: terraform plan for modules/gpu_pool on branch feature/gpu-az-reserve:
```
Plan: 3 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy.
+ aws_autoscaling_group.gpu_az_a
+ aws_autoscaling_group.gpu_az_b
+ aws_ssm_parameter.gpu_token (will be created)
~ aws_launch_template.gpu_launch_template (modification)
```

Kai: infra-bot output shows SSM parameter creation still happens. Morgan pls remove that creation before merging, or mark it as conditional on `create_ssm_param = true` default false.

Morgan: will change to conditional + add docs on secrets workflow. will also add test plan and canary steps in PR. thanks everyone, ping me if you want write access to the PR for quick reviews. :thumbsup:
